summary: Amazon's thesis rests on AWS re-acceleration from AI plus retail margin expansion funding a historic capex cycle; free cash flow is the pressure point.

pillars.title: AWS re-accelerates on AI
pillars.statement: AWS growth holds near 28% or better as AI capacity and custom chips come online.

pillars.title: Retail margins keep expanding
pillars.statement: North America operating margin keeps expanding on regionalized fulfillment and advertising.

pillars.title: Capex earns returns
pillars.statement: AI capex converts into AWS revenue and operating income growth rather than stranded capacity.

risks.title: Free cash flow compression
risks.description: Trailing free cash flow fell to $1.2 billion as capex surged; further declines would pressure the equity story.

risks.title: International volatility
risks.description: International segment profits remain thin and FX-sensitive.

openQuestions.question: Is the custom chips business (Trainium, Graviton) becoming a disclosed growth driver?

catalysts.title: Q3 2026 guidance
catalysts.expectedImpact: Sets the second-half growth and margin bar

authorshipLabel: Demo-authored thesis anchored to Amazon's Q1 2026 release and Q2 guidance (8-K filed 2026-04-29). Not a real institution's view; not investment advice.
